records.statement: Poster/photo/infographic plus caption is a recurring optional starting pattern for Promkes explainer work.
records.scope: Optional input mode; do not assume assets/caption are always present.

records.statement: Audio-first, transcript-first, script-first and hybrid poster/audio/transcript inputs should be supported.
records.scope: Select from supplied materials; never invent acoustic observations, transcript text or timing.

records.statement: Accessible, down-to-earth Indonesian and story-led persuasive communication are recurring preferences.
records.scope: Editable voice profile per campaign, audience and channel.

records.statement: Curiosity-building hooks, useful educational insight and a non-lecturing tone are preferred, but must remain truthful and non-stigmatizing.
records.scope: Creative direction per brief; no deceptive clickbait, fear manipulation or unsupported health claims.

records.statement: A key message and actionable audience CTA are commonly requested.
records.scope: Tie CTA to defined audience and behavior objective; do not globalize campaign-specific CTA.

records.statement: The greeting Halo Sola Seha’ has been requested as a recognizable opener.
records.scope: Optional brand profile element; confirm current brand fit, spelling and authority before reuse.

records.statement: Polewali Mandar local speech flavor has been requested for some community-facing outputs.
records.scope: Use only grounded idioms reviewed for authenticity; do not fabricate dialect or stereotype.

records.scope: Static artwork only. The 1080×1350 px size, 4:5 ratio and logo safe areas do not define video aspect ratio, resolution or scene safe areas.
